note: docs/architecture/velocity_channel.md section 8.1 (coordinator plan 2026-11-10 14:40, first empty-chair closed loop at 0.10 m/s). stage: STAND_TEST (wheels off the ground; with the manual channel: estop with moved_after_reset false, usb_unplugged, dead_man if installed; 3 trials each), GROUND_TEST (adds auto_stand_checks: the test command source on the stand, one speed_ratio per trial, each within 10 %, and estop_trials >= 1 emergency stops during automatic control with moved_after_reset false), SUPERVISED_CLOSED_LOOP (adds braking rows on the ground at the approved top speed for software_zero and source_killed <= 0.18 m, estop and communication_loss <= 0.30 m, dead_man if installed; speed_m_s is the approved limit, e.g. 0.10; estop rows need moved_after_reset false; at least 3 trials, spread <= 20 % of the mean or 0.02 m, heading change <= 5 deg). usb_unplugged: driver_stopped true needs max_stop_time_s <= communication_timeout_s + 0.5 s, or <= 1.5 s while communication_timeout_s is null (a later stop counts as not stopped); driver_stopped false needs the decision, decided_by user or coordinator and decided_at, is accepted only while max_linear_m_s <= 0.10, and drops the communication_loss braking row. communication_timeout_s may be null (not known) only while max_linear_m_s <= 0.10; when given, driver_readback must include communication_timeout and every line-loss stop must come within it plus 0.5 s. owner_killed, orin_power_cut, software_zero and source_killed are optional; one marked verified is checked. Readback requests must be in the wc_motion.driver_readback whitelist: the owner reads them once at session start. Speeds go one step at a time: linear 0.10, 0.20, 0.30 m/s, angular 0.30, 0.40, 0.50 rad/s; the next linear step needs braking rows (GROUND_TEST) or a passed closed_loop_runs entry (SUPERVISED_CLOSED_LOOP) at the step below. Register addresses and expected values stay empty until the readback is reviewed; this template must be rejected.
